tagline: Meet the pieces, listen and explore!
voiceMissing: No device voice is available for this language. Download its voice in Settings.
soundOff: Sound is off. Turn on sound in the app settings to listen.
audioError: Could not start audio. Try again.
demo: Movement example on an empty board
match.title: Play the Computer
match.info: You play White. Beginner level. Pawns automatically promote to queens.
match.moveEffectsHelp: When off, pieces move instantly without sliding.
match.replaceMessage: Starting a new game will delete your current game’s progress and move history.
match.clockHelp: Only the side to move uses time. Clocks pause in settings and while the app is in the background.
match.clockDurationHelp: Changing the duration resets both clocks in an ongoing game. After a game ends, the new duration applies to the next game.
share.title: Share preview
share.gateHelp: Please enter the result to open the sharing preview.
share.privacy: This card contains no child’s name, photo, voice recording or profile information. Sharing is optional.
share.error: Could not prepare the card. Please try again.
reminders.help: Add multiple daily reminders and turn each time on or off. The main switch pauses all reminders. Times stay on this device.
reminders.empty: No reminders yet. Add a time to get started.
reminders.permission: Allow notifications in device Settings to receive reminders.
reminders.capacity: All entries are kept. To respect the notification queue, up to 64 reminders can be active at once. New entries are saved off when needed.
opening.title: Learn openings
opening.example: This is one example line. Your opponent may choose different moves.
opening.practiceHelp: Play both sides in order. Tap the piece, then its destination.
opening.retry: Try the move from this example. Other moves may also be legal.
custom.title: Create Your Game
custom.help: Place both sides by tapping or dragging pieces. You can arrange them automatically, then play against the computer.
custom.rightsHelp: When enabled, only kings and rooks on their starting squares can castle. There is no en passant right in the starting position.
custom.invalid: Check the squares and piece count.
custom.kings: Each side needs exactly one king.
custom.material: Each side may have up to 16 pieces and 8 pawns.
custom.pawns: Pawns cannot be on the first or last rank.
custom.adjacent: Kings cannot be next to each other.
custom.wrongCheck: The side not moving first cannot be in check. Change the first side or the position.
custom.finished: The game is already over in this position. Set up a position where play can continue.
custom.occupied: Opponent pieces occupy starting squares. Clear those squares first.
